column3: following new sections which shall have effect as sections
12A. (1) Notwithstanding anything to the
contrary in this Act or any other written law,
the  Permanent  High  Court  at  Bar  shall  hear,
try and determine in the manner provided for
by  written  law,  subject  to  the  provisions  of
subsection (7), all prosecutions on indictment
against  any  person,  in  respect  of  offences
specified in the Sixth Schedule to this Act, and
any other offence committed in the course of
the same transaction of any such offence.
(2) Such Permanent High Court at Bar shall
consist  of  three  Judges  sitting  together,
nominated by the Judicial Service Commission
from among the Judges of the High Court of
the Republic of Sri Lanka of which one Judge
shall  be  nominated  by  the  Judicial  Service
Commission as the Chairman of  such Court.
